title: Step Functions in one screen
rememberThis: ASL state machine = JSON definition. Task states invoke AWS services or Activity workers.
Standard workflows: durable, full execution history, up to 1 year — use for sagas and business processes.
Express workflows: under 5 minutes, high throughput, lower cost — use for streaming aggregation.
Retry and Catch blocks belong in ASL — do not rely only on Lambda retries inside Task.
Saga = forward steps + compensating tasks on failure; compensators must be idempotent.
bullets: Choice state uses JSONPath ($.status) — typos in paths cause silent wrong branches.
Map state MaxConcurrency limits parallel Lambda invocations over large arrays.
sync:2 integrations wait for Lambda response; async integrations fire-and-forget.
Callback pattern: Task with waitForTaskToken + SQS worker sends task success/failure.
CloudWatch: ExecutionsFailed, ExecutionsTimedOut, ExecutionThrottled alarm these.
